criteria.text: Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.

Identifies the threatened $450,000 claim by Lowther Software Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.

Identifies the conflict between the 20-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 20-day period or aligns the documents.
Flags that the board minutes and the disclosure letter are inconsistent about litigation.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
